name: 6867-deepqueue-opt125m-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8192, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded by wall clock at 480 s; 8192 offered against the 32 admitted in vllm-config.yaml is the declared operating point, not a starting guess.
workload: synthetic synthetic_text, single turn, request_format plain (this checkpoint ships no chat_template), every request exactly 32 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens, greedy (temperature 0.0) with ignore_eos.
purpose: A small-model autocomplete service streaming 256-token completions from 32-token prompts for 8,192 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# A July-2024 engine: an unknown `AsyncEngineArgs` key is a TypeError at construction, so do
# not add keys from a later vLLM. The checkpoint must stay unquantized fp16 -- see env.yaml.

model: facebook/opt-125m
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 32
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
disable-log-stats: false
disable-log-requests: true
